recommendations.title: Add guidance for large multi-chain complexes
recommendations.problem: No guidance on handling large multi-chain complexes (>10 chains, >1000 residues total) which may cause memory or timeout issues
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes typical monomer/dimer inputs; edge cases not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to Limits: 'Large complexes (>10 chains or >1000 residues): may require increased timeout (>300s) or input_pdb_chains to redesign subset. For very large assemblies, consider redesigning chains iteratively rather than entire complex at once.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for sampling
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running ProteinMPNN with same backbone and temperature produces identical sequences
recommendations.fix: Add to Request Pattern: 'Sampling: ProteinMPNN is stochastic — same backbone and sampling_temp will produce different sequences each run (no seed control via API). For reproducible designs, save and version mfasta output rather than regenerating. Lower temperatures (0.1) yield more conservative designs; higher (0.5+) increase diversity.'

recommendations.title: Clarify num_seq_per_target vs sampling_temp interaction
recommendations.problem: num_seq_per_target and sampling_temp both affect output count but interaction not explained (10 seqs × 3 temps = 30 total?)
recommendations.root_cause: Two parameters control output size; combined behavior not documented
recommendations.fix: Add to Common controls: 'Output count: num_seq_per_target × len(sampling_temp) = total sequences. Example: num_seq_per_target=10 with sampling_temp=[0.1, 0.3, 0.5] yields 30 sequences (10 per temperature). mfasta contains all temperatures interleaved.'
